sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State
Counsel for Revisionist :- R.N.Sharma,J.L. Dubey,S.C.Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
Called in revise.
None appeared to press this revision.
However, learned AGA for State of U.P. is present.
2. The original memo of revision is torn and only one half paper is available.
Learned AGA informed that his file is also not traceable.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

3. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., is directed against judgement and order dated 25.08.1988 passed by Sri S.K. Singh, Judicial Magistrate Ist, Karwi, Banda, convicting revisionist Shiv Kumar, under Section 7/16(1)(a)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954") awarding rigorous imprisonment of one year with fine of Rs.
2000/-.
In case of default of payment of fine, accused has to further undergo six months simple imprisonment.
The accused appeal has been dismissed by Sri R.S. Pandey, learned District and Sessions Judge, Banda vide judgement and order dated 08.08.1989.

sentences.text: The basic ground on which this revision has been filed is that there is no compliance of Sections 13(2) and 10(7) of Act, 1954.
Both the Courts below have recorded findings that in compliance of Section 13(2), notices were sent to accused but he did not receive the same.

With regard to non-compliance of Section 10(7), both the Courts below have also recorded findings that an attempt was made to get independent witness at the time of taking sample and seizure but since none came forward, hence, authorities proceeded further.
5.
I do not find that the view taken by Courts below is erroneous or contrary to law and warranting interference.
6. Dismissed.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
7. Certify this judgement to the lower Court immediately.
